extraction.text:
SHRAVANI A N 

Generative AI Engineer | Copilot Studio Developer | LLM Solutions 

Phone: 9611752521/Location: Bengaluru/Email: shravanivani0108@gmail.com 

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 

Generative AI & Copilot Studio Engineer with 2 years of experience building LLM-powered agents, retrieval-based solutions, autonomous agent patterns, and enterprise conversational systems. Skilled in Microsoft Copilot Studio, RAG workflows, Prompt Engineering, and Generative AI solution design. 

CORE EXPERTISE 

Generative AI: 

Large Language Models (LLMs)

Prompt Engineering

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Agentic AI & Autonomous Agents

Generative Answers & Guardrails - Enterprise AI Solution Architecture

Copilot Studio: 

Conversational Agent Design

Topic Authoring, NLU, Multi-turn Flows

Generative Answers with Knowledge Sources

Custom Actions, API Integrations, JSON Parsing

Copilot–Power Automate–Dataverse Integrations

Monitoring, Analytics & Optimization

TECHNICAL SKILLS 

AI Tools: Copilot Studio, AI Builder, Azure AI concepts

Languages: Python, SQL

APIs & Integrations: REST APIs, Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft 365

Tools: GitHub, VS Code ,Graph API

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 

Digital Engineer | Sonata Software Ltd. | 2024 – Present 

Built advanced Copilot Studio agents including L&D Assist Bot, Expense Bot, Knowledge Search Assistant.

Implemented RAG workflows with SharePoint, Dataverse, and generative responses.

Designed LLM reasoning workflows, structured prompts, fallback logic.

Integrated Copilot Studio with Power Automate for automated tasks.



Enhanced accuracy using custom actions, retrieval patterns, and grounding data.

Associate Digital Engineer | Sonata Software Ltd. | 2023 – 2024 

Designed conversation flows and LLM logic in Copilot Studio.

Integrated Dataverse and SharePoint for enterprise GenAI workflows.

Improved AI responses using structured prompts and custom AI builder models.

PROJECTS & POCs 

1. Pizza Ordering Agent – Copilot Studio 

Designed complete ordering flow with generative answers, menu search, and email automation.

2. L&D Virtual Helpdesk (Knowledge Search Bot) 

Created enterprise knowledge assistant using SharePoint KB + Generative AI.

Built guided troubleshooting flows and RAG responses.

3. Expense Status Agent (Dataverse + LLM) 

Built smart expense assistant using LLM prompt flows and Dataverse queries.

CERTIFICATIONS 

Microsoft Applied Skills — Create Agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio - D365 F&O Fundamentals (MB-920)

EDUCATION 

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) 

East West Institute of Technology (VTU), Bengaluru 

CGPA: 8.3 | 2020 – 2022
